profile.summary: HP Adhesives Limited manufactures and distributes adhesives and sealants in India and internationally. Its products include solvent cement, contact adhesives, white glue/PVA, epoxy putty and adhesives, spray paints, and plumbing accessories, as well as cyanoacrylates, synthetic rubber adhesives, black and white sealants, pipe lubricant, and gasket shellacs.
